india: Russia is now India's biggest source of crude oil. The Black Sea route carries grain and sunflower oil, and five Indian sailors have died in attacks on ships there this year.
lede: Ukraine was part of the Soviet Union until 1991, then became independent. Russia sees Ukraine as part of its sphere and opposes its move towards the West. In 2014 Russia took Crimea, and in 2022 it launched a full invasion. Now both sides also attack each other's power plants, refineries and Black Sea shipping.

players.name: Russia
players.role: President Vladimir Putin. Invaded Ukraine in 2022.

players.name: Ukraine
players.role: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Fighting to defend its land.

players.name: USA
players.role: President Trump. Pushing for a deal; eased curbs on Russian diesel.

players.name: Europe
players.role: Backs Ukraine with money and weapons.

players.name: India
players.role: Buys Russian oil. Proposed a 3-part truce on energy and shipping.

timeline.what: Russia takes Crimea from Ukraine. Fighting starts in eastern Ukraine.
Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Fighting has gone on ever since.
India sends Kyiv and Moscow a 3-part plan: no attacks on energy sites, free Black Sea trade, safe ships.
The US lets Russian diesel back into world markets to ease a global fuel shortage. Zelenskyy calls it a gift to Putin.
Trump announces an energy ceasefire. Zelenskyy says Ukraine wasn't told and Russian strikes continued.

title: Russia–Ukraine war, simply
